user.title: KSeF - connection
user.description: Enter your NIP and a KSeF token generated in the KSeF Taxpayer Application (Tokens → Generate token, permission "invoice viewing"). Notifications: pick phones running the Home Assistant app or other notify services; empty = no push.

data.notify_service: Push notifications (pick one or more phones)

reauth_confirm.title: KSeF - new token
reauth_confirm.description: KSeF rejected the token for NIP {nip}. Generate a new one and paste it here.

abort.already_configured: This NIP is already configured for this environment.

refresh.name: Refresh invoices
refresh.description: Fetch the invoice list from KSeF (at most every 2 minutes).
